== Description ==

[[Kyle Krueger]] (left) and [[Karl Koenig]] (right, yellow shirt) in a game, with [[Justin Miyashiro]] (back right, black R2D2 shirt) at the next table, at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025. Remaining faces unlabeled.
